cacheIsolation.mechanism: buildCogniWeaveCacheKey prepends memoryIndexAccessCacheComponent (managed:<tenantId>:<resourceId> | personal_local) ahead of the existing dataRoot/storePath/governance-fingerprint/epoch key, so a same-named agent in another tenant, a changed resourceId, and personal-vs-managed never share a CogniWeave manager instance.
cacheIsolation.revokeTombstoneInvalidatesManaged: the CogniWeave cache key includes getMemoryGovernanceEpoch(); a governance epoch bump (seat transfer / revoke) changes the key, and a tombstoned/revoked handle fails closed on re-resolve (managed_workspace_not_indexable) before any manager is built.

backgroundDefer: managed access without a valid identity / binding returns a structured {manager:null,error} from getMemorySearchManager (never throws); mirrors the existing startGatewayMemoryBackend managed-defer so the gateway stays up.
boundaryNotes: Local index STORAGE is retained (dark handle): the canonical object-store root is not a local FS path. managed_enterprise authorizes via the canonical handle and binds the CogniWeave manager to it (createFromHandle). Object-store-backed managed storage is a separate future concern.
